description: Longtime Labor Leader Elected to Represent Working Families in Northern Nevada Immediate Release Sparks, NV — Former Assemblyman Richard “Skip” Daly has secured enough votes to win election to the Nevada Senate, has declared victory over his Republican opponent, and becomes Senator-elect. Senator-elect Daly will assume the seat of retired Senator Julia Ratti. “I want […]
title: Former Assemblyman Richard “Skip” Daly Wins Key Race in Nevada Senate District 13 - Elect Richard "Skip" Daly
